narratives.body: AllNigeriaSoccer confirmed a French-born Super Falcons-eligible forward joined Chelsea on a professional deal. Soccer News reported Chelsea plans a future move for Strasbourg winger Gessime Yassine. London Evening Standard noted Chelsea beat Man Utd to a signing and highlighted Xabi Alonso's promise regarding Estevao, despite Football London claiming Estevao received brutally honest transfer advice. London Evening Standard revealed Emi Martinez's new aim after surgery and that Penders was handed an opportunity following her injury. CaughtOffside urged a player with 23 minutes of playing time to leave the club. Football London reported a Chelsea wonderkid sent Xabi Alonso an 'awesome' message.
